title: Sentence Arrangement and Grammar — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: "She have a red bag." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: She has a red bag.

items.prompt: "There is three books on the table." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Banyak buku: There are three books.

items.prompt: "I see a elephant at the zoo." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Elephant diawali bunyi vokal: an elephant.

items.prompt: "My brother and I is good friends." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: My brother and I = we, jadi are.

items.prompt: "These book is mine." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Satu buku: This book is mine.

items.prompt: "He can sings very well." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sesudah can, kata kerja tanpa -s: He can sing.

items.prompt: "Him is my best friend." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Di awal kalimat (subjek) dipakai He: He is my best friend.

items.prompt: "The childs are playing." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Jamak child adalah children.

items.prompt: "Ani is more taller than Rudi." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Taller sudah berarti lebih tinggi. Hapus more.

items.prompt: "Can you give I a pencil?" Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sesudah give dipakai me: give me a pencil.

items.prompt: "Two mans are walking." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Jamak man adalah men.

items.prompt: "I am happy because I gets a gift." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: I get, bukan I gets.

items.prompt: Text about Tia's cat: the word for blank (1) is …

stimulus.text: Tia ___ (1) a cat. ___ (2) name is Mimi. Every morning, Mimi drinks milk ___ (3) a small bowl.

items.reteach: Tia = she, jadi has.

items.prompt: Text about Tia's cat: the word for blank (2) is …

stimulus.text: Tia ___ (1) a cat. ___ (2) name is Mimi. Every morning, Mimi drinks milk ___ (3) a small bowl.

items.reteach: Nama milik kucing: Its name.

items.prompt: Text about Tia's cat: the word for blank (3) is …

stimulus.text: Tia ___ (1) a cat. ___ (2) name is Mimi. Every morning, Mimi drinks milk ___ (3) a small bowl.

items.reteach: Minum dari mangkuk: drinks milk from a bowl.

items.prompt: Joni's text: the word for blank (1) is …

stimulus.text: My name is Joni. I ___ (1) eight years old. I have two ___ (2). Their names are Ari and Edo. ___ (3) are very funny.

items.reteach: I am.

items.prompt: Joni's text: the word for blank (2) is …

stimulus.text: My name is Joni. I ___ (1) eight years old. I have two ___ (2). Their names are Ari and Edo. ___ (3) are very funny.

items.reteach: Two + kata benda jamak: brothers.

items.prompt: Joni's text: the word for blank (3) is …

stimulus.text: My name is Joni. I ___ (1) eight years old. I have two ___ (2). Their names are Ari and Edo. ___ (3) are very funny.

items.reteach: Ari and Edo = they.

items.prompt: Picture text: the word for blank (1) is …

stimulus.text: Look at ___ (1) picture. There ___ (2) a big tree. Under the tree, two children ___ (3) reading.

items.reteach: Picture satu, jadi this picture.

items.prompt: Picture text: the word for blank (2) is …

stimulus.text: Look at ___ (1) picture. There ___ (2) a big tree. Under the tree, two children ___ (3) reading.

items.reteach: A big tree (satu): There is.

items.prompt: Picture text: the word for blank (3) is …

stimulus.text: Look at ___ (1) picture. There ___ (2) a big tree. Under the tree, two children ___ (3) reading.

items.reteach: Two children (banyak): are reading.

items.prompt: Sinta's text: the word for blank (1) is …

stimulus.text: Sinta goes ___ (1) school by bus. She is never late ___ (2) she wakes up early. She ___ (3) her bag the night before.

items.reteach: Goes to school.

items.prompt: Sinta's text: the word for blank (2) is …

stimulus.text: Sinta goes ___ (1) school by bus. She is never late ___ (2) she wakes up early. She ___ (3) her bag the night before.

items.reteach: Tidak terlambat karena bangun pagi: because.

items.prompt: Sinta's text: the word for blank (3) is …

stimulus.text: Sinta goes ___ (1) school by bus. She is never late ___ (2) she wakes up early. She ___ (3) her bag the night before.

items.reteach: She + -s: packs.

items.prompt: "___ is your birthday?" "It is on 5 May."
items.reteach: Menanyakan waktu: When.

items.prompt: "___ are you crying?" "Because I lost my toy."
items.reteach: Jawaban because, jadi pertanyaannya Why.

items.prompt: "___ bag is this?" "It is Rina's."
items.reteach: Menanyakan pemilik: Whose.

items.prompt: "___ books do you have?" "I have ten books."
items.reteach: Menanyakan jumlah benda yang bisa dihitung: How many.

items.prompt: "___ is your teacher?" "Mrs. Lestari."
items.reteach: Menanyakan orang: Who.

items.prompt: "___ do you go to school?" "By bicycle."
items.reteach: Menanyakan cara: How.

items.prompt: "How ___ is your sister?" "She is five."
items.reteach: Menanyakan umur: How old.

items.prompt: "___ colour do you like, red or blue?" "Blue."
items.reteach: Memilih dari beberapa: Which.

items.prompt: Mom: "Can you help me, please?" Rio: "___ What can I do?"
items.reteach: Bersedia membantu: Of course!

items.prompt: "Is this your pen?" "Yes, ___."
items.reteach: Is this …? dijawab Yes, it is.

items.prompt: "Are those your shoes?" "No, ___."
items.reteach: Are those …? dijawab No, they aren't.

items.prompt: "___ does Grandma live?" "She lives in Kediri."
items.reteach: Menanyakan tempat: Where.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: a / beautiful / She / has / garden
items.reteach: Kata sifat sebelum kata benda: a beautiful garden.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: is / Where / bag / my / ?
items.reteach: Pola: Where + is + my bag?

items.prompt: Arrange the words: and / Dina / Rudi / cousins / are
items.reteach: Pola: Dina and Rudi + are + cousins.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: like / I / because / mangoes / sweet / they / are

visual.text: I like mangoes because they are sweet.

choices.say: I like mangoes because they are sweet.

visual.text: I like because mangoes they are sweet.

choices.say: I like because mangoes they are sweet.

visual.text: Because I like mangoes they sweet are.

choices.say: Because I like mangoes they sweet are.

visual.text: I mangoes like because sweet they are.

choices.say: I mangoes like because sweet they are.

items.reteach: Pola: I like mangoes + because + they are sweet.

items.prompt: Which sentence is written correctly?

visual.text: Ana and I go to Kediri on Sunday.

choices.say: Ana and I go to Kediri on Sunday.

visual.text: ana and i go to kediri on sunday.

choices.say: ana and i go to kediri on sunday.

visual.text: Ana and I go to kediri on sunday.

choices.say: Ana and I go to kediri on sunday.

visual.text: ana and I go to Kediri on Sunday.

choices.say: ana and I go to Kediri on Sunday.

items.reteach: Huruf kapital untuk awal kalimat, I, nama orang, kota, dan hari.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: book / an / interesting / This / is
items.reteach: Pola: This is + an interesting book.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: not / do / I / like / onions
items.reteach: Pola: I + do not + like + onions.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: can / you / me / help / ?
items.reteach: Pola: Can + you + help + me?

items.prompt: Which sentence has the correct capital letter and punctuation?
items.reteach: Kalimat tanya diawali huruf kapital dan diakhiri tanda tanya.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: big / a / has / Our / garden / school

visual.text: Our school has a big garden.

choices.say: Our school has a big garden.

visual.text: Our school has a garden big.

choices.say: Our school has a garden big.

visual.text: Our has school a big garden.

choices.say: Our has school a big garden.

visual.text: School our has a big garden.

choices.say: School our has a big garden.

items.reteach: Pola: Our school + has + a big garden.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: three / There / pencils / are / my / bag / in

visual.text: There are three pencils in my bag.

choices.say: There are three pencils in my bag.

visual.text: There three are pencils in my bag.

choices.say: There three are pencils in my bag.

visual.text: There are pencils three in my bag.

choices.say: There are pencils three in my bag.

visual.text: In my bag pencils there are three.

choices.say: In my bag pencils there are three.

items.reteach: Pola: There are + three pencils + in my bag.

items.prompt: Join the two sentences with "and": "I like rice. I like noodles."

visual.text: I like rice and I noodles.

choices.say: I like rice and I noodles.

items.reteach: Gabungkan bagian yang berbeda: I like rice and noodles.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: school / to / go / We / by / bus. Which word is in the third place?
items.reteach: Kalimatnya: We go to school by bus. Kata ketiga: to.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: is / My / tall / father. Which word comes last?
items.reteach: Kalimatnya: My father is tall. Kata terakhir: tall.

items.prompt: Odd one out: apple, chair, pencil, sing
items.reteach: Apple, chair, pencil kata benda. Sing kata kerja.

items.prompt: Which word fits both? "I ___ my bike every day." "The bike ___ to the beach is long."
items.reteach: Ride bisa kata kerja (naik) dan kata benda (perjalanan).

items.prompt: How many nouns are in this sentence? "The cat sleeps on the sofa."
items.reteach: Kata benda: cat dan sofa. Ada dua.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a small word. I come before a word that starts with a vowel sound, like apple. What am I?
items.reteach: An apple, an egg, an owl.

items.prompt: "I am go to school." Which word should we take out?
items.reteach: Hapus am: I go to school.

items.prompt: The same word fits both blanks: "___ you like cats?" "Yes, I ___." What is it?
items.reteach: Do you like cats? Yes, I do.

items.prompt: "I" is to "my" as "we" is to …
items.reteach: I → my, we → our.

items.prompt: Count the words: "My little sister likes pink flowers." How many words are there?
items.reteach: My-little-sister-likes-pink-flowers: 6 kata.

items.prompt: Which sentence means the same as "Budi is taller than Andi"?

visual.text: Budi and Andi are the same height.

choices.say: Budi and Andi are the same height.

items.reteach: Kalau Budi lebih tinggi, Andi lebih pendek.

items.prompt: Unscramble the letters to make the plural of "person": O-E-P-P-L-E
items.reteach: Person → people: p-e-o-p-l-e.
